How it's built

The whole philosophy
One file

The whole tool is a single file.

Open it in a browser and it runs. Nothing to install, no setup, no dependencies to break six months from now.

Offline

It works with the internet off.

Your data is read and processed on your machine and never sent anywhere. No servers, no accounts, no quiet uploads.

Explainable

No black boxes.

Every score, match, and recommendation shows its reasons. Same input and same rules always produce the same result.

Yours

Buy once, keep forever.

No subscription, no login, no expiry. The file you download is the product. It can't be turned off from somewhere else.
